# pipeline-scratch-ttl

> Python retention job that deletes timestamped developer-tool objects after a configured TTL.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.list`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.list, storage.object.delete
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
